mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ultary_pet ( user_no, name, species, breed, gender, is_neutered, birthday, profile_file_id, bio ) VALUES ( #{userNo}, #{name}, #{species}, #{breed}, #{gender}, #{isNeutered}, #{birthday}, #{profileFileId}, #{bio} )
mapper.update:
UPDATE ultary_pet SET
name = #{name},
species = #{species},
breed = NULLIF(#{breed}, ''),
gender = #{gender},
is_neutered = #{isNeutered},
birthday = #{birthday},
profile_file_id = NULL,
profile_file_id = #{profileFileId},
bio = NULLIF(#{bio}, ''),
updated_at = NOW() WHERE pet_id = #{petId} AND user_no = #{userNo} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT fp.feed_pet_id, fp.feed_id, fp.pet_id, fp.added_by_user_no, fp.status, fp.approved_by_user_no, fp.approved_at, fp.rejected_at, fp.is_main, fp.created_at, fp.updated_at FROM ultary_feed_pet fp INNER JOIN ultary_pet p ON p.pet_id = fp.pet_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 WHERE fp.feed_pet_id = #{feedPetId} AND p.user_no = #{userNo}
